goal: Add independently enabled browser, Windows computer-control and office application plugins to the source-owned Agent foundation; retain a separately installable core and optional Docker.

acceptance.requirement: Independent browser/computer/office integration entry points and selective CLI activation; disabled application tools do not enter the model context; preserve existing core isolation.

acceptance.requirement: Actual Chromium persistent sessions, tabs, bounded accessibility snapshots and stable element references, navigation, input, selection, screenshots, uploads/downloads, cancellation and deterministic lifecycle cleanup.

evidence.title: managed browser snapshots bind element references to a snapshot and target actual frames, selects and checkboxes
managed browser handles explicit dialogs and actual proxied WebSocket traffic
managed browser cancellation destroys its context, stops queued work and releases profile capacity
actual Chromium navigation, DOM input/click, screenshots, file upload and download

acceptance.requirement: Safe profile paths and ownership, current policy checks before actions, approved endpoints, bounded capacity, reviewed URL/network policy including request and WebSocket paths; CDP detachment preserves user tabs.

evidence.title: browser profiles hash untrusted owner input and repeated opens cannot release an existing profile lock
browser network policy rejects reserved IPv4 and IPv6 forms and local proxy use requires its private credentials
browser project deny policies apply to direct APIs and raw services, including network and screenshot asset writes

acceptance.requirement: Explicitly paired browser extension and configured CDP connection; tab grants, token isolation, revocation and actual extension/transport tests where the host permits.

evidence.title: independent browser pack pairs a real Chrome extension with host URL review, explicit tab grants, screenshots and revocation
browser node transport serializes real WebSocket tasks and revocation marks unconfirmed effects unknown and rejects the pending caller
actual CDP attachment controls a separate browser and disconnect preserves its tabs

acceptance.requirement: Windows native window and accessibility inspection, targeted interaction, screenshot and keyboard/pointer control with exclusive project/run lease, serialized work, cancellation and emergency stop; use a dedicated test application for input verification.

evidence.title: native Windows application pack uses real UI Automation references for targeted values, invoke, toggle and window capture
native targeted SendInput keyboard and pointer actions operate on the dedicated fixture and reject out-of-window coordinates

active native processes recheck revoked permissions and timeouts without retaining their lease queue

acceptance.requirement: Real CSV/XLSX/DOCX/PPTX/PDF reading, structured inspection, generation and source-preserving edits; XLSX range operations and formulas with truthful calculation status; PDF composition and preview; deterministic asset ownership and resource limits.

evidence.title: office pack exposes independent tools and authenticated APIs with project, schema and preview-write enforcement

PPTX inspection follows presentation relationships and source-preserving edits retain images and slide order

PDF generation, page composition, rotation, extraction and raster preview execute on actual PDFs

Office worker cancellation, bounded capacity, closing and CSV formula-neutralization do real work without publishing cancelled output
office edits recheck exact tool policy and source-read authorization after actual worker processing before publishing a derived asset

externalValidation.detail: Paid text/image/video/embedding vendors and model quality/billing require actual credentials.
Actual local Chromium/CDP/loaded extension passed. Installed-user-browser distribution, real production sites/login/CAPTCHA remain separate.
Actual formats, XML edits, PDF pages and raster output passed locally. Installed Microsoft Office/LibreOffice recalculation and full visual fidelity not validated.
Docker remains optional; CLI/engine not installed.

notImplemented.detail: Linux/macOS native computer adapters are not implemented; current native adapter returns 501 off Windows.
No full Excel formula evaluator, full office editor, OCR, arbitrary format conversion or PDF interactive-form flattening.
单用户宿主，不实现多租户边界或分布式电脑租约。Windows AppContainer 命令/Plugin/MCP 文件和网络隔离已有有界实现，见 CORE-FOUNDATION.md；电脑控制本身仍运行在用户桌面会话，隔离 PTY 未实现。
User-browser extension does not implement file upload/download or iframe/ref actions. Managed Chromium supports these operations.

boundaries: Core can install/build without all optional dependencies; Docker is optional.
External CDP/extension reviews actions; it does not proxy all traffic in an existing user browser.
Windows native control runs in the user session; started input cannot be rolled back.
Office workers bound time/heap/concurrency and preflight real archive bytes; not an OS security sandbox.
Unknown disconnected/cancelled remote effects are not automatically replayed.
